snippet.title: Steam page for Crimson Rest is live
snippet.description:
The Steam page for Crimson Rest is finally live! To celebrate, I’ve updated the gameplay trailer with new scenes. Add Crimson Rest to your wishlist on Steam today!

🔗Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3993140?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=steampage
